id: 02_Common Scientific Glassware and the Undergraduate Chemistry Laboratory
title: 认识化学实验室的常用仪器
source_doc: course/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/02_Common Scientific Glassware and the Undergraduate Chemistry Laboratory.md
author_source: project/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/02_Common Scientific Glassware and the Undergraduate Chemistry Laboratory/src.py

points.K9: 布氏漏斗：先夹稳再组装
points.K17: 分液漏斗：塞子和铁圈要合适
points.K33: 会用设备，就是最好的安全

shots.scene: 欣欣站在摆满玻璃仪器的实验台后，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a lab bench full of assorted glassware and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，认识化学实验室的常用仪器。
overlay: 认识化学实验室的常用仪器

shots.scene: 烧杯、量筒、圆底烧瓶、冷凝管四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a beaker, a graduated cylinder, a round-bottom flask and a condenser. No people.
shots.narration: 认得清、选得对、放得稳、用得好。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着量筒在烧杯和锥形瓶之间犹豫
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a lab coat and goggles stands at a bench, holding a graduated cylinder and looking confused at a beaker and a flask.
shots.narration: 阿杰对着一桌玻璃仪器发愣。

shots.scene: 阿杰的手肘差点碰倒一只高量筒，小研伸手扶住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's elbow almost knocks over a tall graduated cylinder; the female graduate student catches it in time.
shots.narration: 一转身，差点碰倒量筒。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the lab bench and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 每件仪器都有它的用法和脾气。

shots.scene: 电影式冒烟烧瓶的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cartoonish smoking, bubbling flask with wild fumes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 真实实验室，不是电影里那样冒烟沸腾。

shots.scene: 整洁的实验室全景：实验台、仪器、试剂柜、通风柜
shots.prompt_en: A wide view of a tidy chemistry teaching lab with benches, instruments, reagent cabinets and fume hoods. No people.
shots.narration: 而是整齐的实验台和各种仪器。

shots.scene: 实验台上整齐摆着各种玻璃仪器
shots.prompt_en: A lab bench with neatly arranged glassware of many shapes and sizes, blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 先把常用的家伙认一认。

shots.scene: 一排从大到小的烧杯
shots.prompt_en: A row of glass beakers from very large to very small on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 烧杯有大有小，从几毫升到几升。

shots.scene: 三个小图：烧杯里反应、端着烧杯转移、烧杯作水浴
shots.prompt_en: Three small icons: a beaker with a reaction, a hand carrying a beaker, and a small vial standing in a beaker of warm water. No people.
shots.narration: 能做反应、能转移液体，还能当水浴。

shots.scene: 小研比较两个烧杯，挑了大小合适的一个
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares two beakers of different sizes and picks the suitable one.
shots.narration: 先想清用途，再挑合适的大小。

shots.scene: 烧杯侧面刻度特写，旁边是约等号
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the graduation marks on a beaker with an approximately-equal symbol beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 烧杯刻度只能估个大概。

shots.scene: 烧杯被红叉，量筒打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A beaker icon with a red X next to a graduated cylinder icon with a green check, both labeled with blank tags. No people.
shots.narration: 要量准体积，得用专门的量器。

shots.scene: 一排不同规格的量筒
shots.prompt_en: A row of graduated cylinders of different sizes standing on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 量筒用来量取液体体积。

shots.scene: 量筒被碰倒的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tall cylinder tipping over at the edge of a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 它又高又细，很容易被碰倒。

shots.scene: 小研把量筒放到实验台内侧、视线前方
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a graduated cylinder at the back of the bench, away from the edge, in clear view.
shots.narration: 放在看得见、少人走动的地方。

shots.scene: 量筒液面放大示意，凹液面底部有箭头
shots.prompt_en: A magnified diagram of a liquid surface in a cylinder, curving down in the middle, with an arrow pointing to the lowest point. No people.
shots.narration: 液面边缘会往上爬，形成凹液面。

shots.scene: 阿杰蹲下平视量筒读数
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends down to read a graduated cylinder at eye level.
shots.narration: 视线放平，读凹液面最低处。

shots.scene: 试管中溶液变色
shots.prompt_en: A test tube held in a rack with a solution changing color inside. No people.
shots.narration: 试管适合做现象明显的小实验。

shots.scene: 试管立在试管架上，滚落的试管图标被红叉
shots.prompt_en: Test tubes standing in a rack; beside it a test tube rolling off a bench icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 试管站不住，用完放回试管架。

shots.scene: 试管夹夹住试管在灯焰上方加热；另一个夹着试管悬在水浴中
shots.prompt_en: Two small panels: a test tube held by a test tube holder above a burner flame, and a test tube held by a holder suspended in a beaker of warm water. No people.
shots.narration: 试管夹能夹着试管在灯焰上加热或放进水浴。

shots.scene: 小研试握试管夹，挑选大小合适的
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tries two test tube holders on a test tube and chooses the one that fits.
shots.narration: 加热前先练稳握法，夹子要配试管。

shots.scene: 一排大小不同的锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: A row of conical flasks of different sizes on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 锥形瓶常用来混合试剂、做反应。

shots.scene: 小研轻轻摇动锥形瓶，溶液在瓶内打转不溅出
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently swirls a conical flask; the pink solution spins inside without spilling.
shots.narration: 瓶口收窄，摇动时不容易洒。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶瓶颈被夹子夹在铁架台上
shots.prompt_en: A conical flask clamped at its neck to a ring stand. No people.
shots.narration: 也方便夹持，所以做反应常选它。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶刻度特写，旁边约等号
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the rough graduation marks on a conical flask with an approximately-equal symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 它的刻度同样不准，别拿来量。

shots.scene: 抽滤瓶特写，侧管被箭头标出
shots.prompt_en: A filter flask with a side arm highlighted by an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 抽滤瓶像锥形瓶，多了一根侧管。

shots.scene: 抽滤瓶倾倒时液体从侧管漏出的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tilted filter flask with liquid leaking out of the side arm, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只用它做减压过滤，别拿来装液体。

shots.section_title: 布氏漏斗：先夹稳再组装
shots.scene: 陶瓷布氏漏斗和黑色橡胶垫圈
shots.prompt_en: A white ceramic Buchner funnel next to a black rubber adapter ring. No people.
shots.narration: 布氏漏斗配橡胶垫圈，密封更好。
overlay: 布氏漏斗：先夹稳再组装

shots.section_title: 布氏漏斗：先夹稳再组装
shots.scene: 老周先把抽滤瓶夹在铁架台上
shots.prompt_en: The older man in a lab coat and goggles clamps a filter flask to a ring stand before adding anything.
shots.narration: 装置头重脚轻，先把抽滤瓶夹稳。

shots.section_title: 布氏漏斗：先夹稳再组装
shots.scene: 老周把带垫圈的布氏漏斗装到抽滤瓶上
shots.prompt_en: The older man places the Buchner funnel with its rubber adapter onto the clamped filter flask.
shots.narration: 再装漏斗，组成抽滤装置。

shots.scene: 玻璃漏斗放在锥形瓶上，内有折叠滤纸
shots.prompt_en: A glass funnel with folded filter paper sitting on top of a conical flask. No people.
shots.narration: 普通玻璃漏斗用于常压过滤。

shots.scene: 两个小图：棉花团和折叠滤纸
shots.prompt_en: Two small icons: a tuft of cotton wool and a folded cone of filter paper. No people.
shots.narration: 可以塞棉花，也可以垫折叠滤纸。

shots.scene: 宽口塑料粉末漏斗放在瓶口上
shots.prompt_en: A wide-stem plastic powder funnel sitting on the neck of a flask. No people.
shots.narration: 往瓶里加固体，用粉末漏斗更方便。

shots.scene: 小研用药匙把白色粉末经粉末漏斗加入烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a spatula to add white powder through a powder funnel into a flask.
shots.narration: 干燥剂、固体试剂都能这样加。

shots.scene: 小研检查漏斗是否干净，用后在水槽清洗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student inspects the funnel for residue, then rinses it at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 用前看干净没有，用后及时洗净。

shots.scene: 几把弯头、平头药匙并排
shots.prompt_en: Several metal spatulas, some curved and some flat, lying side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 取固体用药匙，有弯头也有平头。

shots.scene: 药匙被用力掰弯的图标，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a spatula being forcefully bent, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 能弯一弯，但尽量轻点用。

shots.scene: 玻璃棒在烧杯中搅拌
shots.prompt_en: A glass stirring rod stirring a solution in a beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 短时间搅一搅，用玻璃棒。

shots.scene: 玻璃棒和温度计并排，温度计带刻度和液泡
shots.prompt_en: A plain glass rod next to a thermometer with a bulb and scale, a not-equal sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 别把它和温度计弄混。

shots.scene: 玻璃棒滚向台边的图标被红叉；玻璃棒架在烧杯上打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a glass rod rolling toward the bench edge crossed out with a red X, and a rod resting on a rod holder with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 放下时会滚，要放稳。

shots.scene: 胶头滴管四步图标：挤、插、松、移
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons of a dropper pipette: squeeze the bulb, dip into liquid, release, move to another vessel. No people.
shots.narration: 挤扁胶头，插进液体，松开吸液。

shots.scene: 小研把滴管里的液体滴进另一个烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student transfers liquid from a dropper pipette into another beaker.
shots.narration: 再移到新的容器里。

shots.scene: 滴定管夹在铁架台上，刻度特写
shots.prompt_en: A burette clamped on a stand, close-up of its scale numbers increasing downward, blank numbers. No people.
shots.narration: 滴定管用于滴定。

shots.scene: 滴定管刻度与量筒刻度方向相反的对比图
shots.prompt_en: A comparison diagram: a burette with arrows pointing down the scale next to a cylinder with arrows pointing up. No people.
shots.narration: 刻度从上往下，读出加进去多少。

shots.scene: 容量瓶瓶颈上一条刻线特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a volumetric flask neck with a single etched line. No people.
shots.narration: 配标准溶液，用容量瓶。

shots.scene: 老周检查塞子是否塞紧不晃
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks that a stopper fits snugly in a volumetric flask.
shots.narration: 颈长易倒，塞子要真正配套。

shots.scene: 液面接近瓶颈时，滴管一滴一滴加
shots.prompt_en: Near the neck of a volumetric flask, liquid is added drop by drop with a dropper as the level approaches the line. No people.
shots.narration: 到了瓶颈液面涨得快，要慢慢加。

shots.section_title: 分液漏斗：塞子和铁圈要合适
shots.scene: 分液漏斗里两层液体分界清楚
shots.prompt_en: A separatory funnel holding two clear layers of different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 分离两种不相溶的液体，用分液漏斗。
overlay: 分液漏斗：塞子和铁圈要合适

shots.section_title: 分液漏斗：塞子和铁圈要合适
shots.scene: 分液漏斗倒置，塞子不漏
shots.prompt_en: A separatory funnel held upside down with its stopper firmly in place and no leaks. No people.
shots.narration: 塞子尺寸要对，倒过来才不漏。

shots.section_title: 分液漏斗：塞子和铁圈要合适
shots.scene: 两个铁圈：太小的打叉，太大的打叉，合适的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three ring clamps holding a funnel: one too small with a red X, one too big with a red X, one fitting with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 铁圈太小不稳，太大托不住。

shots.section_title: 分液漏斗：塞子和铁圈要合适
shots.scene: 小研组装分液漏斗的活塞
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student assembles the stopcock of a separatory funnel.
shots.narration: 活塞有的要自己装好再用。

shots.scene: 恒压滴液漏斗，侧管被箭头标出
shots.prompt_en: A pressure-equalizing dropping funnel with its side tube highlighted by an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 恒压滴液漏斗，多了一根平衡管。

shots.scene: 滴液漏斗装在烧瓶上，液滴平稳落下，旁边惰性气体气球图标
shots.prompt_en: A dropping funnel mounted on a flask with steady drops falling, and a gas balloon icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 在保护气下，能平稳连续地滴加。

shots.scene: 分液漏斗与滴液漏斗并排，中间双向箭头
shots.prompt_en: A separatory funnel and a dropping funnel side by side with a two-way arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 用不着磨口时，分液漏斗也能代替。

shots.scene: 老周在陶瓷研钵中研磨晶体
shots.prompt_en: The older man grinds crystals in a white ceramic mortar with a pestle.
shots.narration: 固体要研成粉末，就用研钵和研杵。

shots.scene: 几个大小不同的圆底烧瓶，磨口朝上
shots.prompt_en: Several round-bottom flasks of different sizes with ground glass joints. No people.
shots.narration: 正式的反应，常用圆底烧瓶。

shots.scene: 圆底烧瓶受热均匀的示意：热量箭头四周均匀
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a round-bottom flask with heat arrows spreading evenly around the round surface. No people.
shots.narration: 圆底受热均匀，搅拌也好。

shots.scene: 圆底烧瓶稳稳坐在软木圈上
shots.prompt_en: A round-bottom flask sitting securely on a cork ring. No people.
shots.narration: 它站不住，要放在合适的软木圈上。

shots.scene: 夹子夹住圆底烧瓶磨口处，绿圈标出
shots.prompt_en: A clamp gripping a round-bottom flask at its ground glass joint, highlighted with a green circle. No people.
shots.narration: 固定时夹在磨口处。

shots.scene: 夹子夹在薄壁球体处被红叉
shots.prompt_en: A clamp gripping the thin round body of a flask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 磨口最厚最结实，所有玻璃仪器都如此。

shots.scene: 回流装置：圆底烧瓶上接冷凝管
shots.prompt_en: A reflux setup: a round-bottom flask on a stand with a condenser on top, cooling water hoses attached. No people.
shots.narration: 想让液体沸腾又不跑掉，用回流冷凝管。

shots.scene: 冷凝管剖面示意：蒸气上升、冷凝、回流
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a condenser: vapor rises, turns into droplets on the cold inner tube and drips back down. No people.
shots.narration: 夹套通冷水，蒸气冷凝流回瓶里。

shots.scene: 水流箭头：下口进、上口出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a condenser jacket with a blue arrow entering at the lower side arm and leaving at the upper side arm. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却水从下口进，上口出。

shots.scene: 冷凝管顶端被塞子堵住的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a condenser with its top opening plugged by a stopper, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝管顶端绝不能堵上。

shots.scene: 密闭容器膨胀的警示图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sealed vessel bulging with pressure arrows and a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 压力憋在里面，可能酿成事故。

shots.scene: 老周在铁架台上调整夹子
shots.prompt_en: The older man adjusts a clamp on a ring stand.
shots.narration: 铁架台和夹子用来固定玻璃仪器。

shots.scene: 铁架台一侧挂满仪器倾倒的图标，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a ring stand overloaded on one side and tipping over, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一边挂太重，整个架子会倒。

shots.scene: 仪器挂在底座伸出的一侧，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A ring stand with its apparatus hanging over the long side of its base, marked with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 让重心落在底座伸出的那一侧。

shots.scene: 几种不同夹子并排
shots.prompt_en: Several types of lab clamps side by side: two-prong, three-prong and a ring clamp. No people.
shots.narration: 夹子种类多，要选合适的。

shots.scene: 长色谱柱，底部有活塞，顶部有储液球
shots.prompt_en: A long glass chromatography column with a stopcock at the bottom and a solvent reservoir bulb at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 色谱柱是底部带活塞的长玻璃管。

shots.scene: 几种色谱柱：有磨口、有储液球、有砂芯
shots.prompt_en: Three column variants side by side: one with a ground joint top, one with a reservoir bulb, one with a porous frit at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 有的带磨口、储液球，有的带砂芯。

shots.scene: 大小不同的圆形滤纸
shots.prompt_en: Round filter papers of several sizes in a box. No people.
shots.narration: 滤纸有不同大小和规格。

shots.scene: 细滤纸慢、粗滤纸快的对比图标
shots.prompt_en: A comparison icon: fine filter paper with slow drips and coarse filter paper with fast drips. No people.
shots.narration: 孔越细，过滤越慢。

shots.scene: 滤纸放进布氏漏斗；滤纸吸干固体
shots.prompt_en: Filter paper being laid in a Buchner funnel, and wet crystals pressed between sheets of filter paper. No people.
shots.narration: 能用来过滤，也能吸干固体。

shots.scene: 表面皿上放着少量固体
shots.prompt_en: A watch glass holding a small amount of white solid on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 表面皿能盛放、称量少量固体。

shots.scene: 表面皿晃动的图标，旁边一只轻放的手
shots.prompt_en: A watch glass wobbling on a bench with a gentle hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它容易晃，要轻拿轻放。

shots.scene: 陶瓷蒸发皿里放着湿固体
shots.prompt_en: A white ceramic evaporating dish with high edges holding a wet solid. No people.
shots.narration: 湿固体要晾干，就放进蒸发皿。

shots.scene: 熔点管特写，一端封口
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a thin melting point capillary tube sealed at one end. No people.
shots.narration: 熔点管又细又小，一端是封口的。

shots.scene: 熔点管放在专用小盒里，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Melting point tubes stored in a small dedicated tray with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 给它找个安全的地方放。

shots.scene: 小研把装好样品的熔点管放进熔点仪
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student inserts a loaded capillary tube into a melting point apparatus with a blank display.
shots.narration: 固体从开口装入，放进熔点仪测量。

shots.scene: 核磁管和管帽
shots.prompt_en: A thin NMR tube and its cap lying on a clean tray. No people.
shots.narration: 测核磁谱，要用核磁管。

shots.scene: 小研用滴管把溶液加入核磁管，盖上帽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills an NMR tube with a solution using a dropper, then caps it.
shots.narration: 样品配成溶液，滴管加入，盖好管帽。

shots.scene: 一排通风柜，柜内放着加热搅拌器
shots.prompt_en: A row of fume hoods with sashes partly lowered and a hot plate stirrer inside one. No people.
shots.narration: 反应多在通风柜里做，仪器也住在这。

shots.scene: 加热磁力搅拌器，两个旋钮分别是加热和搅拌图标
shots.prompt_en: A hot plate magnetic stirrer with two knobs, one with a heat icon and one with a rotation icon. No people.
shots.narration: 加热磁力搅拌器，既能加热又能搅拌。

shots.scene: 旋钮旁的温度计图标和问号
shots.prompt_en: A heating knob with a question mark beside it and an external thermometer probe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 旋钮温度未必准，需要校准。

shots.scene: 插入外置温度计探头的示意
shots.prompt_en: A hot plate with an external temperature probe plugged in and dipped into a beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 有的能接外置温度计。

shots.scene: 搅拌子在烧杯中旋转形成漩涡
shots.prompt_en: A magnetic stir bar spinning in a beaker of blue liquid, forming a vortex. No people.
shots.narration: 放进搅拌子，溶液就转起来。

shots.scene: 烧瓶被夹在铁架台上，在搅拌器上方
shots.prompt_en: A flask on a stirring hot plate, firmly clamped to a ring stand. No people.
shots.narration: 搅拌可能很猛，容器要夹住。

shots.scene: 天平上放着空称量纸，显示屏空白，清零按钮被按下
shots.prompt_en: A finger presses the zero button on a lab balance with an empty weighing paper on the pan; blank display. No people.
shots.narration: 称量前，先放容器去皮清零。

shots.scene: 在天平上直接倒固体的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of solid being poured directly onto a balance pan, with spilled powder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别在秤盘上直接倒、直接舀。

shots.scene: 小研把称量纸取下，在台面上加固体，再放回天平
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the weighing paper off the balance, adds solid on the bench, then puts it back.
shots.narration: 取下容器加减固体，再放回称。

shots.scene: 撒在秤盘上的粉末，天平上出现警示图标
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a few spilled grains on a lab balance pan with a small yellow warning triangle icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 残留的固体会损坏昂贵的天平。

shots.section_title: 会用设备，就是最好的安全
shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁指着整齐的仪器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at neatly arranged glassware and equipment on a lab bench.
shots.narration: 会正确使用设备，就是最好的安全。
overlay: 会用设备，就是最好的安全

shots.section_title: 会用设备，就是最好的安全
shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station at a sink. No people.
shots.narration: 进实验室先认清洗眼器。

shots.section_title: 会用设备，就是最好的安全
shots.scene: 紧急喷淋标志和喷淋装置
shots.prompt_en: An emergency shower sign above a safety shower with a pull handle. No people.
shots.narration: 还有紧急喷淋在哪里。

shots.section_title: 会用设备，就是最好的安全
shots.scene: 实验台下几个分类废物桶，标签空白
shots.prompt_en: Several waste containers with blank labels under a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 废物该放哪个桶，也要弄清楚。

shots.section_title: 会用设备，就是最好的安全
shots.scene: 老周给学生讲解实验室布局
shots.prompt_en: The older man shows the young male student and the female graduate student around the lab, pointing at safety equipment.
shots.narration: 每个实验室不同，听老师现场讲。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现烧杯、量筒、锥形瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a beaker, a cylinder and a conical flask.
shots.narration: 烧杯估量，量筒量取，锥形瓶做反应。

shots.scene: 抽滤装置、分液漏斗、回流装置三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a filter flask setup, a separatory funnel in a ring, and a reflux setup. No people.
shots.narration: 抽滤先夹稳，铁圈要合适，冷凝不堵顶。

shots.scene: 夹子夹磨口、铁架台重心、天平去皮三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a clamp on a ground joint, a balanced ring stand, and a balance being zeroed. No people.
shots.narration: 夹磨口，稳重心，去皮后离秤加料。

shots.scene: 洗眼器、紧急喷淋、废物桶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an eyewash station, a safety shower and a waste container with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 会用设备，认清洗眼器、喷淋和废物桶。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的实验台旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a tidy bench of clean glassware.
shots.narration: 认清仪器，用好仪器，下次见！
